text:
Sasha: Quick one — we need to schedule a post-incident review for the embeddings API outage (P1) that hit customers with latency spikes yesterday. Looking for a 60m slot to cover timeline, RCA threads, and action items. Timezone spread NA/EU.

triage-bot: Incident #4921 moved to RESOLVED by @oncall-l2. Postmortem requirement flagged — please schedule within 7 days.

Sasha: Candidate slots (all UTC):
- Tue 2026-03-10 14:00-15:00 UTC
- Wed 2026-03-11 16:00-17:00 UTC
- Thu 2026-03-12 17:00-18:00 UTC
Reply with which you can attend and who will chair. Prefer someone from runtime/serving to run the timeline.

Omar: I can chair the Wed slot (16:00 UTC). I’ll draft the timeline + logs section. Pre-read due Tue EOD (UTC) for reviewers. @Mai can you own customer-impact + comms? @Elaine can you bring the KV cache traces?

Mai: I can do customer-impact & comms. Wed works for me. Will pull customer list and affected orgs, draft the customer note template. FYI I’ll be OOO Wed morning until 15:00 UTC but can join in time.

Elaine: Thu is better for me; Wed might be tight because I have an infra call at 16:15 UTC. If Omar chairs Wed I’ll try to join for the second half. I'll attach the trace snippets to the pre-read.

oncall-l2: I can support timeline verification. If Wed is chosen, I'll hand the paging notes and escalation steps to Omar before the meeting. /remind #incidents in 48h to finalize pre-read

Sasha: Consensus so far = Wed. Omar, can you confirm and send calendar invite? Use 60m + 10m buffer. Also please add an agenda section:
1) Incident summary & customer impact
2) Timeline & mitigation steps
3) Root cause hypotheses + evidence
4) Action items & owners
5) Follow-ups (backports, test coverage)

Omar: Confirmed — I'll create the invite and add Zoom. Tentative title: 'Post-incident review — embeddings API latency (P1)'. Pre-read will be in the doc I create: docs/postmortems/4921-pre-read.md (will paste link once ready).

calendar-bot: Event created: Wed 2026-03-11 16:00-17:10 UTC — 'Post-incident review — embeddings API latency (P1)'. Invitees: Sasha, Omar, Mai, Elaine, oncall-l2, eng-runtime. Conference link: https://zoom.redwood.app/j/123-456

Mai: :thumbsup: Added comms checklist to the pre-read draft.

Elaine: I uploaded a tarball of traces to the pre-read doc (link). Will highlight the KV cache miss spikes at t+120s.

Sasha: OK, action items to track in the meeting — please add as comments in the pre-read doc so we can triage during the call. I'll volunteer to follow up on the postmortem publish and policy changes.

Omar: Assigning owners in the doc now:
- Timeline cleanup: Omar — due Wed EOD UTC
- Customer outreach draft: Mai — due Wed EOD UTC
- KV cache follow-up (investigate root cause): Elaine — due 2026-03-18
- Test coverage for cache eviction: eng-runtime — owner TBD — due 2026-03-25

Sasha: If anyone else wants to attend, add yourself to the invite. We'll run canary replay during the meeting if time permits.

oncall-l2: Noted. I'll attach the incident alert logs to the thread before the meeting.

Omar: Thanks everyone. I'll post the pre-read link in this thread when ready. See you Wed.

triage-bot: Reminder set: pre-read due in 36 hours. Good luck!
